events.title: National Day of the People’s Republic of China | Development Update
events.summary: Happy National Day to Our Chinese Players Dear cultivators, October 1 marks the National Day of the People’s Republic of China, and this year marks 77 years since the country’s founding. To all our Chinese players, I wish you a joyful holiday filled with happiness, relaxation, and plenty of time to enjoy your favorite games! events.title: Version 0.2.2 Update Notes
events.summary: Feature Improvements For now, Reincarnation Rewind preserves the Rank, Quality, and proficiency of every Alchemy Formula and Forging Blueprint. Starting formulas are learned automatically. Other formulas are learned in the new life only when placed in an unlocked inheritance slot or covered by 百艺承阶; otherwise, learning them again restores their saved progress. events.title: Version 0.2.1 Update Notes
events.summary: We apologize for the long wait between updates. This is a major update that essentially rebuilds many of the game’s systems. If you haven’t progressed very far, we recommend starting a new save to experience everything from the beginning. events.title: Version 0.1.4 Update Notes
events.summary: New Features Added a Material Refinement tab to the Alchemy Furnace. Upgrade regular materials at a fixed 3:1 ratio using either chained refinement or only the Quality directly below the target. Choose the target Quality and amount, then preview costs, output, and post-refinement inventory before confirming. events.summary: New Features Added automatic Growth allocation to the 洗炼池. Choose several Growth attributes and either cycle through them in order or always improve the lowest one.
